fit_row_use_count_interpretation: The fit rows' actual_target_uses values (schema=600/dictionary=400) were planned counts emitted before the run. Realized uses in this failed attempt are zero for both artifacts.
root_cause: The harness pre-created the session directory with fs::create_dir, giving mode 0755. Endpoint::open_with_policy calls private_dir, which rejects an existing directory with group/other permission bits. The preserved directory is empty and has no owner/profile marker: rejection preceded every transfer.
fix: Remove harness pre-creation and let Endpoint create the fresh session directory with its required 0700 permissions, matching the previous harness. Production code and cache permission enforcement remain unchanged.
regression: session-permissions-red.txt reproduces Storage using the real session launcher. harness-corrected-tests.txt passes seven tests, including a real artifact seed plus ten distinct small targets, immediate reads, final reopened checks and owned cleanup.
measurement_disposition: Retain this entire attempt, including both fit observations. Any corrected campaign requires new source/executable/plan pins and separate output/cache/artifact paths. No transfer timing observation is excluded and no performance result exists from this attempt.
